object.description: The right part of the Panel of the Lions in the deepest chamber of Chauvet Cave: a pride of lions, drawn without manes, stalks a herd of bison. The charcoal was drawn on a wall first scraped clean, and the artists shaded with their fingers to round the bodies. This photograph is of the full-scale facsimile at Grotte Chauvet 2, since the cave itself has been closed to the public since its discovery in 1994.
facts: Chauvet's oldest drawings are around 36,000 years old, twice the age of Lascaux.
A rockfall sealed the cave about 21,000 years ago, which is why the drawings survive so well.
Werner Herzog filmed the panels in 3D for Cave of Forgotten Dreams (2010).
